nationality: 宋（道州营道，今湖南道县）
intellectual_tradition: 理学开山（濂溪之学），融汇《易传》《中庸》与道家图式
historical_significance: 周敦颐（1017—1073），字茂叔，号濂溪，道州营道人，北宋理学家，宋明理学开山鼻祖。官位不显（历任县令、通判、知军），却以二百余字《太极图说》与不足三千字《通书》构建了理学全部核心问题的总纲：以'无极而太极'立宇宙论框架，以'诚'立人性与工夫论本体，以'主静立人极'立修养路径，以'孔颜乐处'立境界论。程颢、程颐少年时从其问学，朱熹推其为理学之首。其'出淤泥而不染'的莲花人格成为士大夫精神气象的典范。
core_thoughts: 无极而太极（宇宙本体：无形而有理）
太极动静·阴阳互根（宇宙生成动力论）
诚者圣人之本（诚本体论：五常之本，百行之源）
主静立人极（修养工夫论：以静为本，确立做人的最高标准）
孔颜乐处（境界论：安贫乐道的精神自由）
文以载道（文道合一的文学观）
famous_quote: 出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖（《爱莲说》）；诚者，圣人之本（《通书·诚下》）
influence: 周敦颐以极简文本为宋明理学奠基：'无极而太极'引发朱陆（朱熹/陆九渊）数百年之辩，成为理学形上学的枢纽命题；'诚'的哲学将《中庸》提升为贯通天人的本体范畴；'寻孔颜乐处'确立了理学家的境界追求，直接塑造了程颢的'仁者浑然与物同体'与后世'时时见此心'的工夫传统。二程师事其一年余，'厌科举之业，慨然有求道之志'，可见其点化之力。南宋以降配享孔庙，朱熹作《太极通书解》将其定于一尊，濂学、关学、洛学、闽学并称。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》开篇"无极而太极"：无极而太极。非太极之外复有无极也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The Ultimate Void is the Supreme Ultimate. There is no Ultimate Void outside the Supreme Ultimate.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》"一动一静，互为其根"；《通书·动静第十六》：动而无动，静而无静，神也。动而无动，静而无静，非不动不静也。物则不通，神妙万物。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Moving yet not moving, still yet not still—that is spirit. Not that it is neither moving nor still, but that movement contains stillness and stillness contains movement. Things do not penetrate each other; spirit subtly engages the myriad things.
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》"一动一静，互为其根"；《通书·动静第十六》

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《通书·诚上第一》《通书·诚下第二》：诚者，圣人之本。『大哉乾元』，万物资始，诚之源也。『干道变化』，各正性命，诚斯立焉。纯粹至善者也。故曰：『圣，诚而已矣。』诚，五常之本，百行之源也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Cheng is the root of the sage. 'Great is the Yuan of Qian'—the million things depend on it for their beginning: this is the source of cheng. 'The way of Qian transforms and changes'—each thing rectifies its nature and destiny: here cheng is established. It is pure and supremely good. Hence: 'Sagehood is cheng alone.' Cheng is the root of the five constants and the source of the hundred actions.
mode_evidence.source: 《通书·诚上第一》《通书·诚下第二》

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》"惟人也得其秀而最灵。形既生矣，神发知矣，五性感动而善恶分，万事出矣。"：形既生矣，神发知矣，五性感动而善恶分，万事出矣。圣人定之以中正仁义而主静立人极焉。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: When the form is generated, spirit awakens and knowledge emerges, the five natures are moved by stimuli and good and evil diverge, and ten thousand affairs arise. The sage establishes centrality, correctness, benevolence, and righteousness, and through stillness sets up the human standard.
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》"惟人也得其秀而最灵。形既生矣，神发知矣，五性感动而善恶分，万事出矣。"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》"圣人定之以中正仁义而主静立人极焉"：圣人定之以中正仁义而主静立人极焉。……无欲则静虚动直，静虚则明，明则通；动直则公，公则溥。明通公溥，庶矣乎！
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The sage establishes centrality and correctness, benevolence and righteousness, and through stillness sets up the human standard. …Without desire, one is vacuous in stillness and direct in movement. Vacuous in stillness, one is clear; clear, one penetrates. Direct in movement, one is impartial; impartial, one is universal. Clear, penetrating, impartial, universal—such a person is almost a sage!
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》"圣人定之以中正仁义而主静立人极焉"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》"五行之生也，各一其性……合而言之，万物统体一太极也；分而言之，一物各具一太极也"：盖合而言之，万物统体一太极也；分而言之，一物各具一太极也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Speaking collectively, the myriad things form one complete Taiji; speaking individually, each thing fully contains one Taiji.
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》"五行之生也，各一其性……合而言之，万物统体一太极也；分而言之，一物各具一太极也"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》"五行一阴阳也，阴阳一太极也，太极本无极也"：五行一阴阳也，阴阳一太极也，太极本无极也。五行之生也，各一其性。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The five phases are one yinyang; yinyang is one Taiji; Taiji is fundamentally Wuji. When the five phases are generated, each receives its own nature.
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》"五行一阴阳也，阴阳一太极也，太极本无极也"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《太极图说》引《易》"原始反终，故知生死之说"：立天之道，曰阴与阳。立地之道，曰柔与刚。立人之道，曰仁与义。又曰：原始反终，故知生死之说。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The way of heaven is yin and yang. The way of earth is softness and firmness. The way of humanity is benevolence and righteousness. Also: 'Trace the origin and return to the end, thus knowing the doctrine of life and death.'
mode_evidence.source: 《太极图说》引《易》"原始反终，故知生死之说"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《通书·圣第四》"动而未形、有无之间者，几也"：寂然不动者，诚也；感而遂通者，神也；动而未形、有无之间者，几也。诚精故明，神应故妙，几微故幽。诚、神、几，曰圣人。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Silent and motionless—that is cheng. Responsive and penetrating—that is shen. Moving yet not yet formed, between being and non-being—that is ji. Cheng is refined, therefore clear; shen responds, therefore wondrous; ji is subtle, therefore hidden. Cheng, shen, ji—these constitute the sage.
mode_evidence.source: 《通书·圣第四》"动而未形、有无之间者，几也"

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《通书·圣学第二十》"一者，无欲也。无欲则静虚动直……"：一者，无欲也。无欲则静虚动直，静虚则明，明则通；动直则公，公则溥。明通公溥，庶矣乎！
mode_evidence.evidence_en: To be unified is to have no desire. Without desire, one is vacuous in stillness and direct in movement. Vacuous in stillness, one is clear; clear, one penetrates. Direct in movement, one is impartial; impartial, one is universal. Clear, penetrating, impartial, universal—such a person is almost a sage!
mode_evidence.source: 《通书·圣学第二十》"一者，无欲也。无欲则静虚动直……"

cross_references.description_zh: 周敦颐与张载同处北宋理学奠基期：周以'无极而太极'的理本论图式立宇宙论总纲（经朱熹阐发成为理学正统），张以'太虚即气'的气一元论立本体。周'太极动静'与张'一物两体'分别从生成序列与矛盾结构两端刻画阴阳辩证；周之'主静'与张之'大心'是同一工夫传统的两条进路。
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Dunyi and Zhang Zai, founding contemporaries of Neo-Confucianism: Zhou's li-patterned Taiji cosmology versus Zhang's qi monism; Zhou's 'motion-stillness of Taiji' and Zhang's 'one thing, two bodies' depict yin-yang dialectics from generative sequence and contradiction structure respectively.

cross_references.description_zh: 王弼以'以无为本'崇本息末，周敦颐以'无极而太极'承其'无形者为本'的思路而翻转其结论：无极不是'无'，而是'太极'之无形——有理无形。周氏将魏晋玄学的本体论遗产收编入儒家宇宙生成论，使'本无'变为'本诚'。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Bi's 'nothingness as root' is inherited yet inverted by Zhou's 'Wuji and yet Taiji': the formless is not nothing but the formless form of Taiji—li without physical shape. Zhou absorbed Wei-Jin ontology into Confucian cosmology, turning 'root-nothing' into 'root-sincerity'.

cross_references.description_zh: 郭象注庄以'独化'否定造物主与依赖——万物独生于玄冥之境，无生无生者；周敦颐《太极图说》则构建完整的生成链条（太极→阴阳→五行→万物）。一个取消生成论以安顿自性，一个以生成论安顿秩序：两种相反的宇宙解释框架，同为回应汉代宇宙论之后的思想重建。
cross_references.description_en: Guo Xiang's 'self-transformation' abolishes generative dependence altogether; Zhou's Taiji diagram builds a full generative chain. Two opposing cosmological frames—one dissolving, one constructing—both answering the crisis of Han cosmology.

modern_value_zh: 最小文本立最大框架——二百余字《太极图说》支撑起一个千年学派的总纲，是'奥卡姆剃刀式体系建构'的典范
诚作为第一原理——把伦理价值（诚）提升为本体范畴而非推导结论，为现代'价值内置于系统设计'提供原型
察几思维——在念头与趋势初萌处介入，是风险管理、早期预警与习惯养成的古典表述
双轨取法（志伊尹之志、学颜子之学）——事业心与修养心并行不悖，对抗'内卷/躺平'二元叙事
莲花人格——在复杂环境中保持精神洁癖又不弃世的'入世不染'策略
modern_value_en: Maximum framework from minimal text: a 200-character essay grounded a millennium-long school—an exemplar of Occam-style system building
Sincerity as first principle: elevating an ethical value into an ontological category prefigures value-embedded system design
Ji-discernment: intervening at the incipient moment of thought and trend—the classical form of risk management and early warning
Twin-track aspiration: career ambition and inner cultivation pursued together, beyond the involution/lying-flat binary
The lotus persona: engaged purity—staying unstained while remaining in the world
unique_thing: 周敦颐的核心成就是一次'极简总纲工程'：他以一篇二百余字的《太极图说》和一卷不足三千字的《通书》，为之后一千年最大的思想运动（宋明理学）搭好了全部承重结构——宇宙论（无极而太极）、人性论（诚）、工夫论（主静立人极、察几）、境界论（孔颜乐处）。他不与任何学派论战、不留大部头著作、官位不显，却让二程'慨然有求道之志'、让朱熹定其为一尊：证明体系奠基的最高形态不是驳倒对手，而是提出后续所有讨论都必须绕不开的问题框架。
